    ANALYSIS MODES

    Compare results

    Each mode changes one part of the investigation while keeping the experiment, engine version, parameters, and evidence limits visible.

    01 Â· MATHEMATICAL DIFF

    Which assumption changed?

    Compare the declared defaults with your modified parameters, then inspect which output metrics differ.

    Compare a system

    02 Â· OBSERVER SWITCH

    What remains distinguishable?

    Hold one run fixed while changing the observer: exact values, thresholds, bins, parity, or remainders.

    Switch observer

    03 Â· PARAMETER SWEEP

    Where might behavior change?

    Sample a bounded parameter range and preserve every tested value. Unsampled intervals remain unknown.

    Sweep a parameter

    04 Â· CONJECTURE ATTACK

    Test a bounded claim

    Search a stated bounded domain for a witness. No witness found is never presented as an unbounded proof.

    Test a claim
